name: Black Mountain
source:
Black Mountain is a short visual novel exploring my relationship to art and functions as a sort of esoteric artist's statement. The novel takes the player up the Bella Vista Trail to the summit of Black Mountain in Monte Bello Open Space Preserve, a park in Palo Alto, California, punctuated by limited interactive elements and my own introspection.

[From [url=https://percivalias.itch.io/black-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Black Mountain》是一部短篇视觉小说，探索我与艺术的关系，也像是一份晦涩的艺术家自述。作品带玩家沿着贝拉维斯塔步道，登上位于美国加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托的蒙特贝洛开放空间保护区内的黑山山顶，途中穿插少量互动要素与我的自我反思。

[摘自[url=https://percivalias.itch.io/black-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
